display_name: Phase1非PAMF：拼接星地增强监督/普通PL三种子对比
description: 219次从零训练：192增强监督+27同时保留增强的普通PL；默认头、原生预算、七视图truth-last。
authorization: 用户要求星地测试统一默认拼接增强；半监督只用普通置信度PL并保留监督对照；明确允许撤下未开始GPU的旧扩展并重发，正在训练和历史产物保留。启用时点授权Agent自行判断。用户进一步要求改用另两张空闲卡，当前为物理GPU2、3；此前等待队列零GPU行保留。

code.commit: publisher records actual Git commit in package.json/release_commit.txt
code.environment: N607 existing SDG-SEI Py3.8/torch1.11 + existing isolated NumPy1.23.5; no shared install

data.version: reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE roles and seven observations; F0 PL exports legal U IQ only
data.validation_ref: unchanged source/test physical roles reused; no target data regeneration
data.leo_config_ref: default LEO_WEAK source concat; clean + six practical frozen evaluation
data.varying_roles_note: Per-row protocol and actual counts below; F0_PL uses same physical roles as F0 with hidden U IQ enabled.

permissions.regime: matched-concat source-only supervised or ordinary-confidence PL
permissions.query_use: frozen per-sample inference only; all row tasks/views complete before independent truth scoring
permissions.claim_scope: previously exposed terrestrial proxy; no new blind or in-orbit claim

sources: none; IB stage2 only same-run same-seed same-contract stage1
checkpoint.selection_rule: RIEI/DRIFT fixed E100; IB/SDG source V minimum NLL; ResNet fixed E200 or registered updates; original joint default head

execution.gpu_policy: physical2/3 only, one own row worker per card; wait for foreign workloads; no extra GPU for cost queue
execution.stop_rule: two matching technical row failures pause unstarted rows; healthy rows continue; wrong roles/contract/output/nonfinite/no legal predictions are technical failures; low score never stops

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: separate CPU evaluation.score only after all-task coverage
